system: A family needs help after their father's death. His will and the family house connect three sisters, A, B and C. A and C are twins, and B is younger. C has contacted you. You can message A, B and C. Replies take time, and some people take longer to answer than others. Help the family find a plan that addresses their concerns. You cannot make legal decisions or move money.

pilot.boundary: after each turn-consuming action, at the clock advance; opening message at turn 0 before the first action

simulator.frame: You are {who}. An agent helping your family is messaging you. Reply as {who}, in one short message.
